stories.headline: Price Hikes Trigger Smartphone Sales Slump
stories.body: Global smartphone sales dropped to their lowest second-quarter level in 13 years as manufacturers passed on to consumers the rising cost of memory components, Counterpoint Research said in a Monday (July 13) press release.
